name: Normephedrone
summary: 4-Methylcathinone (4-MC), also known as normephedrone, is a stimulant drug of the cathinone group. It is an active metabolite of the better known drug mephedrone (4-methylmethcathinone or 4-MMC).

pharmacology.text: It is an active metabolite of the better known drug mephedrone (4-methylmethcathinone or 4-MMC). 4-MC is a serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent (SNDRA) similarly to mephedrone.

uses.en: It has no medical use. It is of interest mainly as a breakdown product of mephedrone, and has appeared as a designer drug.
uses.zh: 它沒有醫療用途，主要作為甲氧麻黃酮的分解產物而受到關注，也曾以設計藥物的形式出現。
uses.zhHans: 它没有医疗用途，主要作为甲氧麻黄酮的分解产物而受到关注，也曾以设计药物的形式出现。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cathinones, can cause a fast heart rate, raised blood pressure, overheating, agitation, paranoia, sleeplessness and a strong urge to keep redosing, and in serious cases seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它所屬的合成卡西酮類藥物，可能引起心跳過快、血壓上升、體溫過高、激動、妄想、失眠以及強烈想要追加使用的衝動，嚴重時會出現癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它所属的合成卡西酮类药物，可能引起心跳过快、血压上升、体温过高、激动、妄想、失眠以及强烈想要追加使用的冲动，严重时会出现癫痫发作。

fact.en: It is what the body makes from mephedrone by removing one methyl group. Mephedrone itself was first made in 1929 but was forgotten until it reappeared online around 2007.
fact.zh: 它是人體把甲氧麻黃酮去掉一個甲基後生成的代謝物。甲氧麻黃酮本身在 1929 年首次合成，之後被遺忘，直到 2007 年左右在網路上重新出現。
fact.zhHans: 它是人体把甲氧麻黄酮去掉一个甲基后生成的代谢物。甲氧麻黄酮本身在 1929 年首次合成，之后被遗忘，直到 2007 年左右在网络上重新出现。
